description: Bidirectional ROS2 online bridge for the S4 Go2 legged sim2sim policy: live state out at 50 Hz, /cmd_vel in with clamp + deadman. Simulation ground truth only.
relationship_to_p1_plan: Extension of docs/CPP_ROS2_ARCHITECTURE.md's P1 slice for the legged Go2 S4 policy. The Go2W /go2w/ 500 Hz C++ node plan is separate and unimplemented; this bridge makes no claim against it.

command.note: out-of-range commands are clamped, not rejected; stale commands zero the command (deadman)

policy.provenance: actor sha256 recorded in every run_config.json

acceptance_levels.ROS-R0: hash-bound core projection + payload construction, verified without ROS 2
acceptance_levels.ROS-R1: real ros:jazzy DDS round trip: independent probe publishes /cmd_vel, receives all topics, verifies command round trip through sim state
